text: I'm curious about the hockey coach Canale, but I want to keep one thing a mystery: who his assistant coach was at Chicoutimi in the 1990–91 season. Can you find something to read that doesn't give that away?
A bit about the barrio Magueyes would be good. That old estate there dating from 1833 isn't something I want to read about, though; I'd rather it didn't come up at all.
I've had enough of the story of Henry Avery returning to army service in the Second World War. I'd like to read about him without that episode appearing anywhere in the passage.

Rugby and the First World War aren't the parts of Henry Avery's life I want to read about this time. Could you find me something that leaves out both his playing career and his military service in that war?
I'm looking for something about the borough of Hartlepool. I'd like a break from the account of the merger that made it a county borough in 1967, so please pick a passage that doesn't bring that up.
Could you find me some reading about Andrea Arntzen that says nothing about a royal honour she received? I don't want that award story slipping in as an aside either.
For Master of Darkness, I'd rather not be told the name of the person blamed for the killings in London. I'd like something to read about the game that keeps that particular name out.

The archaeologist who first investigated Isesi-ankh's mastaba back in the nineteenth century is someone I don't want identified in my reading. What can you find about Isesi-ankh that leaves me in the dark about that person?
I don't like descriptions that send me hopping from one named street to another. Can you find me something about the suburb Double Bay with no street or road names anywhere in it?
I'd like to read about Mary Winslow Smyth's work without learning which institution gave her a doctorate. Please choose something that keeps that institution unidentified.
